summary: MatterSupport lets an ecosystem owner (a smart home platform such as Apple Home) add Matter accessories to its own setup flow. BifrOSt has no smart-home ecosystem, no Matter stack and no commissioning code, so there is nothing to map to.

features.note: A request to commission a device into an ecosystem; BifrOSt has no ecosystem to commission into
Setup handler extension; BifrOSt has no extension point for accessory setup

Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (matter.rs, matter_cluster.rs, matter_interaction.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. No Matter, Thread or smart-home code in springboard/ or the SDK; a desktop-relevant gap only if smart-home control is wanted

gaps: No smart-home ecosystem or accessory setup flow
No Matter or Thread stack in the system layer
